INSERT INTO pairing_requests ("publicId", "userId", "deviceId", "deviceName", "systemName", status, "expiresAt", code)
               VALUES (gen_random_uuid()::text, $1, $2, $3, $4, 'pending', $5, $6)
               ON CONFLICT ("userId", code) WHERE status = 'pending' DO NOTHING
               RETURNING "publicId"
